# GOV.UK

> The UK government's official digital portal providing comprehensive access to public services, benefits, taxes, and citizen information.

GOV.UK is the primary digital hub for UK citizens and businesses to access government services, guidance, and support. The site covers a broad range of life events and administrative needs, from benefits and tax compliance to travel, employment, and housing.

## Key Topics

- Universal Credit
- HMRC
- State Pension
- Self Assessment
- National Insurance
- Jobseeker's Allowance
- Employment and Support Allowance
- Child Benefit
- Tax-Free Childcare
- Inheritance Tax
- Equality Act
- MOT
- Government Services
- Financial Support
- Public Services

## Core Services Directory

- [Welcome to GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk): UK government portal for services, benefits, pensions and public information
- [Services and information - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse): Directory of government services by category and life events
- [Departments, agencies and public bodies - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/government/organisations): Directory of UK government departments and public bodies

## Financial Support & Benefits

- [Benefits - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/benefits): Guide to financial support including Universal Credit and allowances
- [Money and tax - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/tax): Tax guidance including Self Assessment and HMRC services
- [Working, jobs and pensions - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/working): Employment rights, pensions, job search and redundancy support
- [Disabled people - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/disabilities): Disability benefits, rights, carers support and Equality Act guidance

## Life Events & Personal Services

- [Births, deaths, marriages and care - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/births-deaths-marriages): Services for civil events, parenting, divorce and Power of Attorney
- [Childcare and parenting - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/childcare-parenting): Support for childcare, parenting, adoption and child benefits
- [Education and learning - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/education): Student finance, apprenticeships and higher education guidance
- [Housing and local services - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/housing-local-services): Housing, council tax, planning and local government services

## Travel, Citizenship & Immigration

- [Visas and immigration - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/visas-immigration): UK visa types, immigration guidance and asylum information
- [Passports, travel and living abroad - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/abroad): Passport services, travel advice and expat support
- [Citizenship and living in the UK - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/citizenship): Information on UK citizenship, voting and community participation

## Business & Employment

- [Business and self-employed - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/business): Guidance on business setup, tax compliance and regulatory requirements
- [Employing people - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/employing-people): Employer guidance on payroll, hiring, contracts and compliance

## Driving, Transport & Environment

- [Driving and transport - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/driving): Vehicle tax, MOT, driving licences and transport regulations
- [Environment and countryside - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/environment-countryside): Guidance on flooding, recycling, farming and wildlife management

## Crime, Justice & Legal

- [Crime, justice and the law - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/justice): Legal processes, courts, police and victim support services

## Optional

- [Cookies on GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/help/cookies): Cookie policy and management settings for GOV.UK website
